safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Reduce SAP safety lead time from 3.0 to 2.5 days

narrative: Material PL1__MDBDEA7C exhibits moderate demand variability (CV=0.57) with no statistically significant trend over the observation window (May 2025–March 2026). Lead times are highly unstable (CV=0.43, range 0.04–6.72 days), which is the primary driver of the large combined uncertainty (σ_LTD=720.42). The current SAP safety stock of 192 units is critically understated, covering only ~27% of the statistically required buffer; raising it to 1,185 units is essential to achieve the 95% service level. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ-based order quantity of 1,411 units is recommended, well within the 4,143-unit storage cap.
warnings: SAP safety stock (192) is 517% below the statistically required level (1185) for 95% service level.
Lead time variability is high (CV=0.43); supplier performance stabilisation is strongly advised.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Moderate-to-high demand variability and unstable lead times favour a continuous-review fixed-reorder-point policy. The EOQ order quantity (1,411) is well above MOQ (358), making the MOQ non-binding and the EOQ cost-optimal. Continuous review minimises exposure during the uncertain lead time window.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage utilisation at recommended policy is 62.7% (2,596 of 4,144 units), providing adequate headroom. No capacity constraint binds.
